svg.title: Five Rivers: a map for 5 kings and their peasants
svg.desc: Each king's hall is an oval cliff-top on the rim, long along the edge, with a graded ramp facing its peasants and bots-only switchbacks up the other three sides. Rivers run out from a lake between the realms; peasants cross them by bridge or ford, and the lake by bridge to the isle and its vent.
svg.text: 5 kings, 3 peasants each · 28 × 28 map (14336 game units square) · 5 teams of 4, 20 players
Each king's hall is an oval cliff-top on the rim, long along the edge, with a graded ramp facing its
peasants and bots-only switchbacks up the other three sides. Rivers run out from a lake between the
realms; peasants cross them by bridge or ford, and the lake by bridge to the isle and its vent.
Heights: rim 220, 140 nearer the lake · valleys down to the water · rivers and lake 60 deep, fords 10 deep · bridges 16 · isle 60 · halls 340
Planet Bloom · a bioluminescent night world
Ground: teal moss fields glowing at their edges, blue-grey rock on the hall cliffs, cyan-lit
Plants: kapoktree and oaktree_b as giant alien trees, orangemushrooms in glowing rings by the
Features: pilha_crystal_teal, pilha_crystal_lime and pilha_crystal_blue along the rivers and on the
isle, rocks30_moss on the hall mesas.
Sky and weather: dark violet night sky, blue mist over the rivers; wind 3 to 12; tidal 20.
Each fifth is the same, turned 72° about the centre. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
